My recommendation

Keep your masterclass. Put a $27 reset in front of it, and let ads fill both

You already have the class, the credentials and a method with a name. What's missing is a self-paced product that ads can sell every day: a 3-day reset at $27, a journal add-on at checkout, your Manifestation Masterclass recording offered straight after purchase, and your application on the welcome page. The front end brings revenue in from day one, which helps pay for the ads.

Sound familiar?

Who is this for?

Three days, about 15 minutes a day. It's self-paced and you keep lifetime access.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The affirmation that didn't stick"

Hook
"If you've said the affirmation a hundred times and it still doesn't feel true, the affirmation isn't the problem." (to camera, on the leather chair, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"Your mind holds on to old beliefs for a reason. Before a new intention can land, you have to notice the thought underneath it, question it, and let it go. That's the psychology. The release is where the spirituality comes in." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach exactly how in The 3-Day Mindmap Reset. Fifteen minutes a day, twenty-seven dollars. Tap Learn more."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for a limiting belief"

Hook
"Next time a thought tells you 'that's not for people like me', ask it these three questions." (Hannah holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: where did I first learn this? Two: is it protecting me from something? Three: who would I be without it, just for today?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"Day 2 of my 3-Day Mindmap Reset goes deep on this. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Psychology or spirituality?"

Hook
"People ask me if mindset work is psychology or spirituality. My honest answer: you need both." (walking, natural light)
Body
"I studied psychology, so I know how the mind builds a belief. And I've seen that real change happens when you also let it go at a deeper level. My reset puts both together in three short days."
CTA
"It's called The 3-Day Mindmap Reset, and you can start today. Tap Learn more. Educational coaching content, not therapy."
